title: A Broader Look into MLLM's Retrieval Heads
author: Jia Wang, Yuqing Li, Jiangnan Li, Zheng Lin et al.
description: Locating relevant evidence in long inputs is a core capability of Multimodal Large Language Models. Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output. summary: Locating relevant evidence in long inputs is a core capability of Multimodal Large Language Models. Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output.
takeaways: Moreover, how retrieval heads can be leveraged to enhance the model calls for further exploration.
Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output.
Across 18 language, vision-language, and omni-modal checkpoints, omni-modal models largely preserve the retrieval heads of their backbones.
